headline: Banco de Bogotá Names Former Mines Minister as New President
summary: Banco de Bogotá named a former Colombian mines and energy minister, who previously led Banco Popular for three years, as its new president.
why: Banco de Bogotá is a core banking subsidiary of Grupo Aval, Colombia's largest financial conglomerate, playing a pivotal role in credit distribution across the country.

impacts.name: Banco de Bogotá
impacts.why: The Colombian commercial bank appointed a seasoned former minister and bank executive as president.
